items.title: Transcranial magnetic stimulation combined with functional near-infrared spectroscopy to elucidate the neurophysiological mechanisms of post-stroke hemiplegia: a systematic review
items.summary: Patients with hemiplegia after stroke often suffer from motor dysfunction, and their recovery is frequently limited by the imbalanced interhemispheric competition and abnormal neural network reorganization. The combined application of transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) has provided a novel closed-loop neuromodulation strategy for the assessment and intervention of post-stroke motor function. items.summary: Background Acute branch atheromatous disease (BAD) is one of the leading contributors to morbidity and disability in Asia, and early neurological deterioration (END) is common in affected patients. This study aimed to establish machine learning models to predict the risk of END in patients without reperfusion therapy. items.title: FieldTrip: Open Source Software for Advanced Analysis of MEG, EEG, and Invasive Electrophysiological Data
items.summary: This paper describes FieldTrip, an open source software package that we developed for the analysis of MEG, EEG, and other electrophysiological data. The software is implemented as a MATLAB toolbox and includes a complete set of consistent and user-friendly high-level functions that allow experimental neuroscientists to analyze experimental data. It includes algorithms for simple and advanced analysis, such as time-frequency analysis using multitapers, source reconstruction using dipoles, distributed sources and beamformers, connectivity analysis, and nonparametric statistical permutation tests

items.title: Image processing with ImageJ
items.summary: Wayne Rasband of NIH has created ImageJ, an open source Java-written program that is now at version 1.31 and is used for many imaging applications, including those that that span the gamut from skin analysis to neuroscience. items.title: Copper-Zinc Superoxide Dismutase (SOD1) Is Released by Microglial Cells and Confers Neuroprotection against 6-OHDA Neurotoxicity
items.summary: Microglial-neuronal interactions are essential for brain physiopathology. items.title: Tensor Decompositions and Applications
items.summary: This survey provides an overview of higher-order tensor decompositions, their applications, and available software. A tensor is a multidimensional or N-way array.
